title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
synopsis: A young boy known as the Avatar must master the four elemental powers to save a world at war — and fight a ruthless enemy bent on stopping him.

episodes.title: Aang
episodes.synopsis: An Airbender comes to grips with his new reality as war erupts. A century later, a pair of Water Tribe siblings make a discovery that changes everything.

episodes.title: Warriors
episodes.synopsis: Aang, Katara and Sokka arrive at a small Island, home to elite warriors named after Avatar Kyoshi. The Fire Nation gets wind of the Avatar's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Omashu
episodes.synopsis: News of a traitor puts the trio at odds in Omashu, where a mechanist and rebels with a charming leader muddle their plans to protect the Earth Kingdom.

episodes.title: Into the Dark
episodes.synopsis: In captivity, Aang meets a king with a taste for games. To find their friend, the siblings must navigate a dark tunnel — and put their differences aside.

episodes.title: Spirited Away
episodes.synopsis: When the group lands in the Spirit World for a rescue mission, they come face to face with dangerous threats, painful memories and a mysterious entity.

episodes.title: Masks
episodes.synopsis: A desperate Aang visits Avatar Roku for help on his journey as the Fire Nation closes in on him. At their fortress, a masked intruder breaks Aang out.

episodes.title: The North
episodes.synopsis: As an attack on the Northern Water Tribe looms, Katara challenges a master Waterbender, Sokka meets a princess, and Aang takes Kuruk's words to heart.

episodes.title: Legends
episodes.synopsis: Zhao leads the Fire Nation into the North with a bold plan to weaken the Water Tribe. When the battle takes a dark turn, Aang enters a powerful state.

episodes.title: Somewhere Safe
episodes.synopsis: Determined to learn earthbending, Aang works to free Bumi from prison. Zuko chafes at Iroh's plan to stay hidden. Azula receives a new assignment.

episodes.title: A Fight, Once Begun
episodes.synopsis: At a high-stakes earthbending match, Aang discovers the teacher he's been seeking. Painful memories emerge after Zuko befriends a farming family.

episodes.title: City of Walls and Secrets
episodes.synopsis: Aang and his friends must trade powers for parties and politics as they navigate the two-faced court of the Earth King.

episodes.title: The Water Falls, the Stones Emerge
episodes.synopsis: Toph puts Aang's skills to the test. In the streets of Ba Sing Se, Sokka searches for a missing friend, while Katara lives a double life.

episodes.title: Ten Thousand Things
episodes.synopsis: To uncover a mythic library that could hold the key to defeating the Fire Nation, the team is forced to ally with an old enemy.

episodes.title: The Parable of the Two Dragons
episodes.synopsis: When one of their own is captured, the team concocts a risky plan to reach the Earth King. An illness changes Zuko's perspective — and Iroh's.

episodes.title: Something Broken
episodes.synopsis: Torn across the city as the Fire Nation closes in, the team must reunite to save Ba Sing Se — and Zuko must decide where his real loyalties lie.
